note: No capability is PRODUCTION until immutable external real-workload evidence satisfies the qualification thresholds. Repository tests and synthetic browser corpora are correctness gates, not substitutes for external field evidence.

capabilities.title: Bounded Playwright capture to faultline.capture.v1
capabilities.evidence: Caller-owned page adapter with bounded DOM/CSS/diagnostics and explicit dependency rejection. External-case capture/replay coverage is not yet large enough for production qualification.

capabilities.title: Deterministic portable action protocol
capabilities.evidence: Contract/runtime now cover click, hover, pointer move, value/checked changes, key press, focus/blur, scroll, select option and bounded sequences. Browser-runner execution remains pending on the current hardening SHA.

capabilities.title: Deterministic failure oracles + causal fingerprint v1
capabilities.evidence: Every executed case carries a causal fingerprint; reductions reject different failures and require an independent final rerun. External false-equivalence measurement is pending.

capabilities.title: Hierarchical HTML/CSS/JS reduction with per-trial SAME_CAUSE enforcement
capabilities.evidence: Structural scanners + ddmin + ancestor pin closure now evaluate every candidate against the original causal fingerprint rather than accepting arbitrary FAIL states. External release-corpus evidence remains pending.

capabilities.title: Caller-owned in-situ Playwright execution
capabilities.evidence: Live runner and runtime-bound action reducer are implemented with reset-before-trial, richer Playwright-native interactions, causal fingerprints and explicit UNRESOLVED outcomes. Browser qualification has not yet executed on this SHA.

capabilities.title: Runtime-bound reproducer evidence artifact
capabilities.evidence: Artifact is explicitly non-portable, binds immutable source commit/reset identity/fingerprints/metrics, strips URL query/hash credentials and rejects placeholder source SHAs.

capabilities.title: Immutable external-case production qualification
capabilities.evidence: Qualification code rejects mutable/placeholder case identities and blocks any PRODUCTION capability claim unless sample-size, reproduction, same-cause and false-equivalence thresholds are satisfied. Qualifying external corpus has not yet executed.

capabilities.title: Sandboxed portable candidate execution
capabilities.evidence: Browser iframe boundary remains restrictive and network/navigation attempts fail closed. This is browser containment, not VM isolation.

capabilities.title: WebMCP + window.faultline agent surface
capabilities.evidence: Revision-guarded canonical runtime and cancellation surface retained; organisational hardening SHA still requires executable runner verification.

capabilities.title: CLI + CI reproduce/reduce/verify
capabilities.evidence: CLI, hosted CI and a trusted self-hosted production-ci qualification path are defined. Hosted verification is currently blocked by account quota and the self-hosted runner is not yet registered.

capabilities.title: Shared multi-tenant hostile-code execution service
capabilities.evidence: Explicit non-goal. Requires process/VM isolation, identity, quotas, namespaces and scheduling outside the current browser-local architecture.
